faq.q: Is Google Gemini safe for privacy?
faq.a: Gemini is safe to install from Google Play. By default, Gemini Apps Activity is saved to your Google account and may be reviewed to improve Google's products; turn it off or set auto-delete in Settings → Gemini Apps Activity.

faq.q: Can I remove Gemini from my phone?
faq.a: On many phones Gemini is a system app. You can switch your default assistant back to Google Assistant where Google still offers it, or disable the Gemini app in Settings → Apps. On some phones you can also uninstall its updates.

faq.q: Gemini vs ChatGPT: which is better?
faq.a: Gemini works with Gmail, Calendar, Maps and other Google apps and can be your phone's assistant. ChatGPT is strong at open-ended writing and has a large set of custom GPTs. Try both on the same task.
According to Google's latest Play release notes, Gemini 4 Argon is Google's newest frontier model, built for harder multi-step problems, deeper reasoning and advanced coding and analysis.
